message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc. sells design, emulation and test solutions across the full lifecycle to customers in AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor and general electronics, reporting through the Communications Solutions Group and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group [D1]. Communications Solutions Group revenue was $1,345 million in the quarter ended 2026-07-31, growth of 43.09% on a year earlier, and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group revenue was $501 million, growth of 21.60% on a year earlier [D1]. Total segment revenue of $1,846 million matched reported revenue of $1,846 million for the quarter, against cost of products and services of $630 million and research and development expense of $312 million [D1].
